thought.text: cms (35581) and boards (38377) are up; the app dev server (34237) died during the outage. Let me restart it.

reasoning_content:
Interesting:
- 35581 (cms): 200 ✓
- 38377 (boards): 200 ✓
- 34237 (app): 000 (connection failure) — the app's dev server seems to have stopped.

The app dev server was running at 21:42, and via the proxy it returned 200 at around 21:45. After that, something stopped it (probably the sandbox instability during the second outage — nohup processes get killed when the sandbox session is reset… no wait, actually the container keeps running; but it's a different story if the sandbox "session" is restarted and the processes get killed).

Let's restart the app's dev server.

action.command:
cd /workspace/app && nohup pnpm nx serve app --configuration=instance --port=34237 --host=0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts=app.workspace.localhost > /tmp/app-direct2.log 2>&1 &
echo "app pid $!"; sleep 150; grep -aE "Local:.*34237|bundle generation" /tmp/app-direct2.log | tail -2; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 60 http://127.0.0.1:34237/ 2>&1); echo "127.0.0.1:34237 -> HTTP ${code:-timeout}"
